notes.title: Version 1.2 has been released
notes.notes:
Update version 1.2 has been released.
What has been fixed:
- A library that was considered dangerous by some antiviruses has been removed.
-A visual bug with the portal was fixed.
-A bug was fixed where achievements were not counted.
-Was fixed a bug with a white screen at the end of the game.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes: The second part of the puzzle of the millennium has appeared. Hurry to solve it to speed up the appearance of a hidden path.

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.notes: A bug has been fixed that makes the final location broken, as well as a few more minor bugs.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes: Saves for chapters have been added. Was added the ability to quickly move to the start, and added a progress indicator.

notes.title: New release date
notes.notes: In connection with the technical problems, the release of the game will be postponed for 2 days. Expected release date - June 29
